revision: camera fit study; not an integrated electronic product

camera.placement: single central nose camera; two decorative expression eyes
camera.status: manufacturer hole layout used in original carrier; physical mounting and optics unverified
camera.implemented_runtime: operator-enabled real JPEG capture through rpicam-still; hardware not tested

compute.candidate: Raspberry Pi 5 4GB bench prototype; Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5 4GB with eMMC and wireless for product feasibility
compute.dimensions_scope: CM5 module only; excludes custom carrier, connectors and cooling
compute.reference_baseline: Microduck official runtime uses Radxa Zero 3; a separate compatibility baseline, not a drop-in Pi camera host
compute.status: proposed architecture; no ARM board benchmark, carrier design, thermal test or hardware integration yet

microphone.status: not selected or integrated; input capture, echo cancellation and motor-noise tests required

speaker.status: not selected or integrated; amplifier, acoustic cavity and measured output required

imu.status: not selected or integrated; timing, calibration and vibration isolation required

range_sensor.selection_gate: Add only if obstacle-distance tests require a dedicated sensor; not a second camera by default
range_sensor.status: candidate selection and optical crosstalk/latency tests pending

foot_contact.status: sensor/load-cell or estimated-contact design pending for B2 and Q4

power.status: battery, protection, motor supply, logic regulator, fuse and current limits not designed
power.motor_candidate: XL330-M288-T, manufacturer operating range 3.7–6.0 V; recommended 5.0 V; independently regulated motor rail
power.simulation_discrepancy: Existing BAM experiments use 7.4 V for reference reproduction. This is outside the XL330 published operating range and is not a physical power recommendation; recalibration/re-evaluation at selected hardware voltage required.
